answer: Each agent must lock a stake-bond for several epochs, and every epoch a liveness pulse signed by its key is broadcast to peers. A new identity can only have a haven in the registry after paying that bond; forging many wallets becomes costly since each fake node burns real stake and must sustain the pulse or forfeit funds. Attackers cannot cheaply forge identity because sock-puppet accounts cost the same as honest ones. Operator sa0005 applies this at Qzw3Qz2BzJ.
